key.name: position
key.summary: Screen edge the dock floats along

key.name: behavior
key.description: always: visible and reserves space; intellihide: hides only when a window overlaps it; autohide: appears when the pointer reaches the screen edge.

key.name: icon-size
key.summary: Preferred icon size in pixels; shrinks automatically when apps do not fit

key.name: show-running
key.summary: Show running applications that are not favorites

key.name: show-apps-button
key.summary: Show an applications button at the end of the dock (the Start button already opens the launcher)

key.name: show-start-button
key.summary: Show the JERONIX Start button (opens the JERONIX Launcher) at the head of the dock

key.name: show-search-button
key.summary: Show the Search button (GNOME search: applications, files, settings)

key.name: style
key.summary: Full-width Windows 11-style taskbar, or a floating dock (side positions are always floating)

key.name: alignment
key.summary: Where the apps sit on the taskbar

key.name: system-tray
key.summary: Show Quick Settings and the clock with notifications in the bar (bottom only)

key.name: hide-top-bar
key.summary: Hide GNOME's top bar while the bar carries the system tray

key.name: show-task-view-button
key.summary: Show the Task View button (windows and workspaces overview)

key.name: start-menu-shortcut
key.summary: Keyboard shortcut that opens the Start menu

key.name: show-previews
key.summary: Show window previews when hovering a running application
